entities.name: HIV-1 Env gp160
observations: Sequence is 768 aa and matches reviewed HIV-1 gp160 references at 75.5–79.8% identity with near-full query coverage.
gp160 is processed by host furin-like proteases into gp120 and gp41; gp120 mediates host receptor attachment and gp41 drives viral membrane fusion.
Mature Env forms a homotrimer of gp120-gp41 heterodimers.
Reported localization includes virion envelope/membrane, host plasma membrane, and host endosome membrane.

entities.name: HIV host-cell entry
observations: Env attachment to CD4 and a chemokine coreceptor followed by viral-host membrane fusion supports HIV entry into target cells.

entities.name: Virion envelope
observations: HIV-1 Env is a viral envelope spike associated with the virion membrane.

entities.name: Host-cell membrane
observations: HIV-1 Env is also reported at host plasma and endosomal membranes during viral entry.
